🎬 Only the Brave (2017)

Only the Brave tells the powerful true story of the Granite Mountain Hotshots, an elite team of firefighters from Prescott, Arizona, who risk their lives battling some of the most dangerous wildfires in America. Led by the determined Eric Marsh, the crew works tirelessly to earn recognition as a certified hotshot team while facing extreme conditions, unpredictable fires, and personal challenges. Among them is Brendan McDonough, a young man trying to rebuild his life and find purpose through firefighting. As the team develops an unbreakable bond, their courage and dedication are tested during the devastating Yarnell Hill Fire of 2013. Combining intense action, emotional storytelling, and extraordinary real-life heroism, the film explores brotherhood, sacrifice, family, resilience, and the bravery of those who put their lives on the line to protect others.

🎭 Genre: Biography • Drama • Action

⭐ IMDb: 7.6/10

⏱️ Runtime: 2h 14m • PG-13

🎥 Director: Joseph Kosinski

🏆 Recognition: Starring Josh Brolin, Miles Teller, Jeff Bridges, Jennifer Connelly, and Taylor Kitsch, the film received praise for its emotional performances, realistic firefighting sequences, and respectful tribute to the 19 firefighters who lost their lives in the Yarnell Hill Fire.

📺 Where to Watch: Check Amazon Prime Video, Apple TV, and Fandango at Home for current streaming, rental, or purchase availability. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: Only the Brave, subtitled The True Story of the Granite Mountain Hotshots in previews, is a 2017 American biographical drama film directed by Joseph Kosinski, and written by Ken Nolan and Eric Warren Singer, based on the GQ article "No Exit" by Sean Flynn. The film tells the story of the Granite Mountain Hotshots, an elite crew of firefighters from Prescott, Arizona, who lost 19 of 20 members while fighting the Yarnell Hill Fire in June 2013, and is dedicated to their memory. It features an ensemble cast, including Josh Brolin, James Badge Dale, Jeff Bridges, Miles Teller, Alex Russell, Taylor Kitsch, Ben Hardy, Thad Luckinbill, Geoff Stults, Scott Haze, Andie MacDowell, and Jennifer Connell
